human-terse.case: A terse review with grammar slips and no catalog trope.

curly-quotes.case: A clean review whose only findings are the curly quotes of a word processor, which do not affect readability.

nonnative-idioms.case: A review by a non-native writer, with idioms and filler phrases next to grammar slips.

pasted-fields.case: A review that pastes its weaknesses into the detailed comments.

light-polish.case: A clean review with em-dash glyphs and words such as "leverage", which are minor and need no feedback.

ai-written.case: A review with an inflated opening, negative parallelism, duplicated content, and a signposted conclusion.

short-dense.case: A short review of two paragraphs, both dense with catalog tropes.

mixed-reviewers.case: One submission with three reviews, of which only the second has catalog tropes.

ai-with-slips.case: A review dense with catalog tropes that also has two typos.
